LEGACY RESERVE
BARBER'S BLEND
12 PRECISION INGREDIENTS. ZERO FILLERS. ONE STANDARD.
THE SCENT
SANTAL NOIR
Warm sandalwood. Resinous amber. Bergamot top notes. The scent that makes people stop mid-conversation and ask what you're wearing. Deep, warm, masculine. Stays on skin. Gets compliments.
EXPLORE THE FORMULA →
LIQUID GOLD
SEA BUCKTHORN CO₂
The Holy Fruit of the Himalayas, 12,000 ft elevation
Documented in Tibetan healing texts since the 13th century. Over 200 skin-regenerating phytonutrients. The rarest ingredient in this formula.
RARE BOTANICAL
MARULA OIL
Cold-pressed, Southern Africa
Known as the elixir of youth. Penetrates instantly, fortifies skin barrier, locks in moisture.
SIGNATURE OIL
ROSEHIP FRUIT OIL
Wild rose bushes of the Andes Mountains, Chile and Argentina
Triple antioxidant punch. Regenerates at the cellular level. Reverses damage most men never knew they had.
RESTORATIVE OIL
TAMANU SEED OIL
Coastal Polynesia and Southeast Asia
Anti-inflammatory, barrier-restoring, scar-repairing. The ingredient that quietly heals while everything else conditions.
LUXURY CARRIER
ARGAN KERNEL OIL
Hand-pressed from the Argan tree, Morocco
Liquid gold. Conditions every strand root to tip. Eliminates frizz. Natural shine that speaks for itself.
SKIN RENEWAL
BROCCOLI SEED OIL
Cold-pressed, natural silicone alternative
Replaced synthetic chemicals in premium formulas worldwide. Weightless slip, heat protection, mirror-like shine.
JOJOBA SEED OIL
Sonoran Desert, USA
Chemically identical to your skin's own sebum. The only oil that genuinely regulates oil production rather than masking it.
AVOCADO OIL
Cold-pressed, nutrient-dense
Penetrates deeper than almost any carrier oil. Strengthens the hair shaft from the inside out.
SUNFLOWER SEED OIL
Cold-pressed carrier base
Rich in Vitamin E and linoleic acid. Lightweight, non-comedogenic, delivers every ingredient deeper.
SWEET ALMOND OIL
Mediterranean origin, cold-pressed
One of the oldest grooming oils in history. Softens, smooths, carries the full formula with zero heaviness.
TOCOPHEROL
Natural Vitamin E antioxidant
Keeps every ingredient potent from the first drop to the last. Nothing oxidizes. Nothing goes to waste.
FRAGRANCE
Santal Noir blend
The finishing signature. Warm, grounding, masculine. The scent people remember.
$50.00
$38.00
Founder's Rate — 2oz bottle while supplies last
ADD TO CART
BUY NOW
What's Inside
Eleven Ingredients.
Every One Earned.
No fillers. No fragrance oil padding. Every botanical in this formula was chosen because it works — and because the man using it deserves to know exactly what's on his skin.
◆
Rare
01
Sea Buckthorn CO2
Regeneration & Richness
The powerhouse. Rich in omega fatty acids and antioxidants — repairs damage, boosts cell regeneration, and gives skin and hair a visible glow.
Exotic
02
Tamanu Oil
Healing & Barrier Repair
Deep healing. Clinically studied for its ability to regenerate skin tissue and reduce inflammation. Works hard underneath the surface.
Exotic
03
Marula Oil
Luxury Absorption
Lightweight luxury. Absorbs fast, locks in moisture, and protects against environmental damage without leaving any residue.
Proven
04
Rosehip Oil
Rosa Canina — Renewal
The regenerator. Packed with vitamin A and essential fatty acids that smooth texture and support healthy skin and hair growth.
Proven
05
Argan Oil
Argania Spinosa — Strength & Shine
Liquid gold. Tames frizz, adds shine, softens beard hair, and protects against heat and breakage.
Foundation
06
Jojoba Oil
Simmondsia Chinensis — Skin Identical
Nature's closest match to your skin's own sebum. Balances oil production and keeps both skin and beard hydrated without clogging pores.
Deep Penetration
07
Avocado Oil
Persea Gratissima — Deep Penetration
Deep conditioning. Rich in vitamins A, D, and E — penetrates the hair shaft to strengthen from the inside out.
Foundation
08
Sweet Almond Oil
Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis — Softening
The smoothing agent. Softens skin and beard hair while locking in moisture for an all-day hold on hydration.
Foundation
09
Sunflower Oil
Helianthus Annuus — Lightweight Base
The lightweight carrier. Delivers every other ingredient deeper into the skin without heaviness or grease.
Protector
10
Pure Vitamin E
d'Alpha Tocopherol — Antioxidant
The protector. Fights free radicals, reduces oxidative stress, and keeps your skin looking sharp longer.
Signature
11
Signature Scent Accord
Sandalwood · Bergamot · Vanilla
Sandalwood. Bergamot. Vanilla. Warm, clean, masculine — built to complement not compete.
Active botanicals. Zero fillers. One standard.
How to Use
Three Steps.
That's All It Takes.
◆
I
Warm It
Dispense 2-4 drops into your palm and rub your hands together to activate the botanicals and release the scent.
Morning or night. Both if you want to.
II
Work It In
Apply through damp or dry hair and beard. Work from root to tip — don't rush it. Let the formula do its job.
Works with every hair type and beard length.
III
Carry Yourself Differently
That's it. No rinse. No residue. Just the version of yourself that took 60 seconds to invest in the details.
The kind of scent that gets noticed before you say a word.
Add to Cart — $38
The Scent
Built to Be Remembered.
Not loud. Not generic. Just the kind of scent that stays with a room after you leave it.
This isn't cologne. It's the finishing layer of a man who has his standard locked in.
Get Yours — $38 →
Top Note
Bergamot
The lift. Bright and clean with a subtle citrus edge — the note that keeps it from ever feeling heavy.
Heart Note
Sandalwood
The foundation. Warm, woody, grounding. The note that anchors everything else and gives the formula its masculine depth.
Base Note
Vanilla
The finish. Smooth, warm, just enough sweetness to make the whole accord feel complete without going sweet.
◆
Together they create something that feels intentional. Because it was.
Why It's Different
Not Another Oil.
There are a thousand grooming oils. This isn't one of them.
◆
◆
Zero Fillers
Most grooming oils are 80% carrier oil with a few drops of actives. Every ingredient in Barber's Blend earns its place — nothing is in here to bulk up the formula.
◆
Dual Use
One formula for hair and beard. Not a compromise — a deliberate decision to build something versatile enough to work across both without sacrificing performance in either.
◆
Made With Intention
Formulated from the ground up in Lafayette, Louisiana. Not manufactured by a private label factory following a template. Built ingredient by ingredient with a specific man in mind.
◆
The Standard
Legacy Reserve is the flagship because it set the bar for everything GCC builds. If it doesn't meet this standard, it doesn't carry this name.
◆
Our Promise
Built to Back It Up.
If Barber's Blend isn't the best grooming oil you've ever used, reach out. We'll make it right. No complicated process. No hoops to jump through. Just a brand that stands behind what it builds.

Legacy Reserve — Barber's Blend Grooming Oil

Rooted in barbershop culture. Formulated with intention. Built for the man who holds himself to a standard.

Barber's Blend is a dual-use hair and beard grooming oil crafted from active botanicals — zero fillers, zero shortcuts, zero compromise. Every ingredient in this formula was chosen because it performs. Nothing made the cut just to fill space.

This is grooming elevated. A single formula that conditions, strengthens, and finishes — leaving hair and beard looking sharp and feeling healthy without the grease, without the buildup, and without the synthetic filler ingredients most brands hide behind.

What's Inside

◆ Active botanicals — every ingredient earns its place ◆ Dual-use formula — works for hair and beard ◆ Lightweight, non-greasy finish ◆ Signature scent accord — warm, masculine, refined ◆ Zero fillers. Zero synthetic padding. Zero compromise.

How to Use

Warm 2–4 drops between your palms and work through damp or dry hair and beard. Style as usual. Use morning or night — or both.

The Details

2 fl oz / 60ml — Crafted in Lafayette, Louisiana

      (function setHeaderHeighCustomProperties() {
        const header = document.querySelector('header-component');
        const headerGroup = document.querySelector('#header-group');
        const hasHeaderSection = headerGroup?.querySelector('.header-section');

        if (!header || !headerGroup) return;

        const headerTopRow = header.querySelector('.header__row--top');
        const headerHeight = header.offsetHeight;

        let headerGroupHeight = 0;
        const children = headerGroup.children;
        for (let i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
          const element = children[i];
          if (element === header || !(element instanceof HTMLElement)) continue;
          headerGroupHeight += element.offsetHeight;
        }

        if (header.hasAttribute('transparent') && header.parentElement?.nextElementSibling) {
          headerGroupHeight += headerHeight;
        }

        document.body.style.setProperty('--header-height', `${headerHeight}px`);
        document.body.style.setProperty('--header-group-height', `${headerGroupHeight}px`);

        if (headerTopRow) {
          window.requestAnimationFrame(function () {
            document.body.style.setProperty('--top-row-height', `${headerTopRow.offsetHeight}px`);
          });
        }

        if (!hasHeaderSection || !header?.hasAttribute('transparent')) {
          document.body.style.setProperty('--transparent-header-offset-boolean', '0');
          return;
        }

        const hasImmediateSection = hasHeaderSection.nextElementSibling?.classList.contains('shopify-section');
        const shouldApplyOffset = !hasImmediateSection ? '1' : '0';
        document.body.style.setProperty('--transparent-header-offset-boolean', shouldApplyOffset);

<script>
  (function () {
    'use strict';

    var reveals = document.querySelectorAll('.ls-reveal');
    if (!reveals.length) return;

    var eachReveal = function (callback) {
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(reveals, callback);
    };

    var revealAll = function () {
      eachReveal(function (el) {
        el.classList.add('ls-visible');
        el.classList.remove('ls-ready');
      });
    };

    var motionOk = window.matchMedia && !window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

    if (!motionOk || !('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
      revealAll();
      return;
    }

    try {
      eachReveal(function (el) { el.classList.add('ls-ready'); });

      var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
        entries.forEach(function (entry) {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            entry.target.classList.add('ls-visible');
            entry.target.classList.remove('ls-ready');
            observer.unobserve(entry.target);
          }
        });
      }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -30px 0px' });

      eachReveal(function (el) { observer.observe(el); });
      window.setTimeout(revealAll, 1600);
    } catch (error) {
      revealAll();
    }
  })();
</script>

Creatine + Electrolyte Performance Formula
Creatine Hydration Powder is a blend that brings together creatine monohydrate and key electrolytes to support consistent training and muscular energy. Electrolytes like magnesium, sodium, and potassium help maintain hydration and support normal muscle and nerve function.

      (function setHeaderHeighCustomProperties() {
        const header = document.querySelector('header-component');
        const headerGroup = document.querySelector('#header-group');
        const hasHeaderSection = headerGroup?.querySelector('.header-section');

        if (!header || !headerGroup) return;

        const headerTopRow = header.querySelector('.header__row--top');
        const headerHeight = header.offsetHeight;

        let headerGroupHeight = 0;
        const children = headerGroup.children;
        for (let i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
          const element = children[i];
          if (element === header || !(element instanceof HTMLElement)) continue;
          headerGroupHeight += element.offsetHeight;
        }

        if (header.hasAttribute('transparent') && header.parentElement?.nextElementSibling) {
          headerGroupHeight += headerHeight;
        }

        document.body.style.setProperty('--header-height', `${headerHeight}px`);
        document.body.style.setProperty('--header-group-height', `${headerGroupHeight}px`);

        if (headerTopRow) {
          window.requestAnimationFrame(function () {
            document.body.style.setProperty('--top-row-height', `${headerTopRow.offsetHeight}px`);
          });
        }

        if (!hasHeaderSection || !header?.hasAttribute('transparent')) {
          document.body.style.setProperty('--transparent-header-offset-boolean', '0');
          return;
        }

        const hasImmediateSection = hasHeaderSection.nextElementSibling?.classList.contains('shopify-section');
        const shouldApplyOffset = !hasImmediateSection ? '1' : '0';
        document.body.style.setProperty('--transparent-header-offset-boolean', shouldApplyOffset);
      })();

      (function setHeaderMenuStyle() {

          const hasReachedMinimum = overflowList && overflowList.hasAttribute('minimum-reached');
          headerComponent.dataset.menuStyle = isTouchDevice || hasReachedMinimum ? 'drawer' : 'menu';

      })();

<script>
  (function () {
    'use strict';

    var reveals = document.querySelectorAll('.ls-reveal');
    if (!reveals.length) return;

    var eachReveal = function (callback) {
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(reveals, callback);
    };

    var revealAll = function () {
      eachReveal(function (el) {
        el.classList.add('ls-visible');
        el.classList.remove('ls-ready');
      });
    };

    var motionOk = window.matchMedia && !window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

    if (!motionOk || !('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
      revealAll();
      return;
    }

    try {
      eachReveal(function (el) { el.classList.add('ls-ready'); });

      var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
        entries.forEach(function (entry) {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            entry.target.classList.add('ls-visible');
            entry.target.classList.remove('ls-ready');
            observer.unobserve(entry.target);
          }
        });
      }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -30px 0px' });

      eachReveal(function (el) { observer.observe(el); });
      window.setTimeout(revealAll, 1600);
    } catch (error) {
      revealAll();
    }
  })();
</script>

    <script>
      (function setHeaderHeighCustomProperties() {
        const header = document.querySelector('header-component');
        const headerGroup = document.querySelector('#header-group');
        const hasHeaderSection = headerGroup?.querySelector('.header-section');

        if (!header || !headerGroup) return;

        const headerTopRow = header.querySelector('.header__row--top');
        const headerHeight = header.offsetHeight;

        let headerGroupHeight = 0;
        const children = headerGroup.children;
        for (let i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
          const element = children[i];
          if (element === header || !(element instanceof HTMLElement)) continue;
          headerGroupHeight += element.offsetHeight;
        }

        if (header.hasAttribute('transparent') && header.parentElement?.nextElementSibling) {
          headerGroupHeight += headerHeight;
        }

        document.body.style.setProperty('--header-height', `${headerHeight}px`);
        document.body.style.setProperty('--header-group-height', `${headerGroupHeight}px`);

        if (headerTopRow) {
          window.requestAnimationFrame(function () {
            document.body.style.setProperty('--top-row-height', `${headerTopRow.offsetHeight}px`);
          });
        }

        if (!hasHeaderSection || !header?.hasAttribute('transparent')) {
          document.body.style.setProperty('--transparent-header-offset-boolean', '0');
          return;
        }

        const hasImmediateSection = hasHeaderSection.nextElementSibling?.classList.contains('shopify-section');
        const shouldApplyOffset = !hasImmediateSection ? '1' : '0';
        document.body.style.setProperty('--transparent-header-offset-boolean', shouldApplyOffset);
      })();

      (function setHeaderMenuStyle() {
        const headerComponent = document.querySelector('#header-component');
        if (headerComponent) {
          const isTouchDevice = 'ontouchstart' in window && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 0;
          const overflowList = headerComponent?.querySelector('overflow-list');
          const hasReachedMinimum = overflowList && overflowList.hasAttribute('minimum-reached');
          headerComponent.dataset.menuStyle = isTouchDevice || hasReachedMinimum ? 'drawer' : 'menu';
        }
      })();

<script>
  (function () {
    'use strict';

    var reveals = document.querySelectorAll('.ls-reveal');
    if (!reveals.length) return;

    var eachReveal = function (callback) {
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(reveals, callback);
    };

    var revealAll = function () {
      eachReveal(function (el) {
        el.classList.add('ls-visible');
        el.classList.remove('ls-ready');
      });
    };

    var motionOk = window.matchMedia && !window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

    if (!motionOk || !('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
      revealAll();
      return;
    }

    try {
      eachReveal(function (el) { el.classList.add('ls-ready'); });

      var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
        entries.forEach(function (entry) {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            entry.target.classList.add('ls-visible');
            entry.target.classList.remove('ls-ready');
            observer.unobserve(entry.target);
          }
        });
      }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -30px 0px' });

      eachReveal(function (el) { observer.observe(el); });
      window.setTimeout(revealAll, 1600);
    } catch (error) {
      revealAll();
    }
  })();
</script>

GENESIS — Gut Health & Microbiome Formula
Gut Health is formulated to provide comprehensive support for your digestive system, promoting a balanced gut environment and overall wellness. This dietary supplement combines Apple Cider Vinegar Powder, known for its natural digestive properties, and Inulin, a prebiotic fiber from Jerusalem artichoke root, to nourish beneficial gut bacteria.*
Lactobacillus acidophilus, a well-known probiotic, further aids in maintaining normal gut balance by promoting healthy intestinal flora. Along with DigeZyme®, a multi-enzyme complex, this formula helps support the breakdown of nutrients, promoting good absorption and digestion.*
Ideal for daily use, Gut Health is designed to help you feel your best from the inside out. Take 1-2 servings daily with water to support your digestive system and maintain overall gut health.*

      (function setHeaderHeighCustomProperties() {
        const header = document.querySelector('header-component');
        const headerGroup = document.querySelector('#header-group');
        const hasHeaderSection = headerGroup?.querySelector('.header-section');

        if (!header || !headerGroup) return;

        const headerTopRow = header.querySelector('.header__row--top');
        const headerHeight = header.offsetHeight;

        let headerGroupHeight = 0;
        const children = headerGroup.children;
        for (let i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
          const element = children[i];
          if (element === header || !(element instanceof HTMLElement)) continue;
          headerGroupHeight += element.offsetHeight;
        }

        if (header.hasAttribute('transparent') && header.parentElement?.nextElementSibling) {
          headerGroupHeight += headerHeight;
        }

        document.body.style.setProperty('--header-height', `${headerHeight}px`);
        document.body.style.setProperty('--header-group-height', `${headerGroupHeight}px`);

        if (headerTopRow) {
          window.requestAnimationFrame(function () {
            document.body.style.setProperty('--top-row-height', `${headerTopRow.offsetHeight}px`);
          });
        }

        if (!hasHeaderSection || !header?.hasAttribute('transparent')) {
          document.body.style.setProperty('--transparent-header-offset-boolean', '0');
          return;
        }

        const hasImmediateSection = hasHeaderSection.nextElementSibling?.classList.contains('shopify-section');
        const shouldApplyOffset = !hasImmediateSection ? '1' : '0';
        document.body.style.setProperty('--transparent-header-offset-boolean', shouldApplyOffset);
      })();

<script>
  (function () {
    'use strict';

    var reveals = document.querySelectorAll('.ls-reveal');
    if (!reveals.length) return;

    var eachReveal = function (callback) {
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(reveals, callback);
    };

    var revealAll = function () {
      eachReveal(function (el) {
        el.classList.add('ls-visible');
        el.classList.remove('ls-ready');
      });
    };

    var motionOk = window.matchMedia && !window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

    if (!motionOk || !('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
      revealAll();
      return;
    }

    try {
      eachReveal(function (el) { el.classList.add('ls-ready'); });

      var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
        entries.forEach(function (entry) {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            entry.target.classList.add('ls-visible');
            entry.target.classList.remove('ls-ready');
            observer.unobserve(entry.target);
          }
        });
      }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -30px 0px' });

      eachReveal(function (el) { observer.observe(el); });
      window.setTimeout(revealAll, 1600);
    } catch (error) {
      revealAll();
    }
  })();
</script>

Elevate your hydration routine with Passion Fruit HYDRATION, a delicious drink that combines essential electrolytes to keep you hydrated and energized. Ideal for any activity level, from marathon gaming to marathon running, HYDRATION delivers pure, clean refreshment with a delightful, uplifting taste. Enjoy the unique, sweet taste of Passion Fruit in a convenient, tasty form.
Key Highlights of Passion Fruit HYDRATION:
• Premium Formulation: Our formula avoids fillers and unnecessary additives, focusing on delivering essential nutrients.*
• All-Day Consumption: Suitable for consumption throughout the day.*
• Keto Friendly: Designed to fit into various dietary lifestyles.*
• Various nutrients: Contains essential nutrients to support overall health.*
• Supports Muscle Function: Helps maintain proper muscle function and endurance.*
• Enhances Endurance: Boosts stamina for both physical and mental activities.*
• Caffeine-Free and Uplifting Taste: Enjoy the refreshing taste without caffeine or sugar.*
Ideal For:
• Athletes: Supports hydration and endurance for high-energy activities.*
• Professionals & Students: Helps maintain hydration and focus throughout the day.*
• Anyone Seeking Hydration: Perfect for those looking to stay hydrated and healthy with a clean, refreshing drink.*
Discover the Difference:
HYDRATION is more than just a drink; it’s a commitment to supporting your active lifestyle and helping you stay hydrated and energized. With a focus on balance, wellness, and taste, it's time to move beyond sugary drinks and temporary fixes. Embrace the clean, sustained hydration of our Passion Fruit HYDRATION and feel the difference in your day.
Ready for a Refresh?
Try our Passion Fruit HYDRATION today and experience the pure, clean refreshment of Passion Fruit flavor.

        const header = document.querySelector('header-component');
        const headerGroup = document.querySelector('#header-group');
        const hasHeaderSection = headerGroup?.querySelector('.header-section');

        if (!header || !headerGroup) return;

        const headerTopRow = header.querySelector('.header__row--top');
        const headerHeight = header.offsetHeight;

        let headerGroupHeight = 0;
        const children = headerGroup.children;
        for (let i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
          const element = children[i];
          if (element === header || !(element instanceof HTMLElement)) continue;
          headerGroupHeight += element.offsetHeight;
        }

        if (header.hasAttribute('transparent') && header.parentElement?.nextElementSibling) {
          headerGroupHeight += headerHeight;
        }

        document.body.style.setProperty('--header-height', `${headerHeight}px`);
        document.body.style.setProperty('--header-group-height', `${headerGroupHeight}px`);

        if (headerTopRow) {
          window.requestAnimationFrame(function () {
            document.body.style.setProperty('--top-row-height', `${headerTopRow.offsetHeight}px`);
          });
        }

        if (!hasHeaderSection || !header?.hasAttribute('transparent')) {
          document.body.style.setProperty('--transparent-header-offset-boolean', '0');
          return;

        const hasImmediateSection = hasHeaderSection.nextElementSibling?.classList.contains('shopify-section');

  (function () {
    'use strict';

    var reveals = document.querySelectorAll('.ls-reveal');
    if (!reveals.length) return;

    var eachReveal = function (callback) {
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(reveals, callback);
    };

    var revealAll = function () {
      eachReveal(function (el) {
        el.classList.add('ls-visible');
        el.classList.remove('ls-ready');
      });
    };

    var motionOk = window.matchMedia && !window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

    if (!motionOk || !('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
      revealAll();
      return;
    }

    try {
      eachReveal(function (el) { el.classList.add('ls-ready'); });

      var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
        entries.forEach(function (entry) {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            entry.target.classList.add('ls-visible');
            entry.target.classList.remove('ls-ready');
            observer.unobserve(entry.target);
          }
        });
      }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -30px 0px' });

      eachReveal(function (el) { observer.observe(el); });
      window.setTimeout(revealAll, 1600);
    } catch (error) {

HYDROS— Advanced Hydration Powder (Peach Mango)
Elevate your hydration routine with Peach Mango HYDRATION, a delicious drink that combines essential electrolytes to keep you hydrated and energized. Ideal for any activity level, from marathon gaming to marathon running, HYDRATION delivers pure, clean refreshment with a delightful, uplifting taste. Enjoy the unique, sweet taste of Peach Mango in a convenient, tasty form.
Key Highlights of Peach Mango HYDRATION:
• Premium Formulation: Our formula avoids fillers and unnecessary additives, focusing on delivering essential nutrients.*
• All-Day Consumption: Suitable for consumption throughout the day.*
• Keto Friendly: Designed to fit into various dietary lifestyles.*
• Various nutrients: Contains essential nutrients to support overall health.*
• Supports Muscle Function: Helps maintain proper muscle function and endurance.*
• Enhances Endurance: Boosts stamina for both physical and mental activities.*
• Caffeine-Free and Uplifting Taste: Enjoy the refreshing taste without caffeine or sugar.*
Ideal For:
• Athletes: Supports hydration and endurance for high-energy activities.*
• Professionals & Students: Helps maintain hydration and focus throughout the day.*
• Anyone Seeking Hydration: Perfect for those looking to stay hydrated and healthy with a clean, refreshing drink.*
Discover the Difference:
HYDRATION is more than just a drink; it’s a commitment to supporting your active lifestyle and helping you stay hydrated and energized. With a focus on balance, wellness, and taste, it's time to move beyond sugary drinks and temporary fixes. Embrace the clean, sustained hydration of our Peach Mango HYDRATION and feel the difference in your day.
Ready for a Refresh?
Try our Peach Mango HYDRATION today and experience the pure, clean refreshment of Peach Mango flavor.
Ingredients: Vitamin B1 (Thiamin), Vitamin B2 (Riboflavin), Vitamin B3 (Niacin), Vitamin B6 (Pyridoxal 5 Phosphate), Vitamin B9 (Folate), Vitamin B12 (Methylcobalamin), Calcium (Calcium Citrate), Magnesium (Magnesium Citrate), Sodium (Sodium Citrate), Potassium (Potassium Citrate), Polydextrose, Citric Acid, Natural & Artificial Flavors, Sucralose, Calcium Silicate, Fruit & Vegetable Blend (for color)
Flavor: Peach Mango
Manufacturer's country: USA
Product amount: 5.71 oz / 0.36 lb / 162 g
Gross weight (oz/lbs/g): 7.2 oz / 0.45 lbs / 204 g
Suggested use: Measuring with the scooper located inside the jar, mix each scoop, to desired taste, with 14-20 ounces (414-591 ml) of water (2 scoops with 28-40 ounces (828 ml-1.2 1) of water).
Warning: Recommended to not exceed more than 5 scoops within a 24 hour period. Not intended for use by persons with a medical condition. Consult your physician before using this product if you are pregnant of nursing or taking any medication.
Manufactured in a facility that produces Milk, Eggs, Fish, Shellfish, Tree Nuts, Peanuts, Wheat, Soybeans, and Sesame.
Store in a cool dry place, keep out of reach of children. Do not use if safety seal is broken or missing. Contents sold by weight not volume, some settling may occur. Secure lid tightly when not in use. Consume within 90 days.
This product is intended to supplement a balanced diet and active lifestyle. Consult with a healthcare professional before starting any new dietary supplement, especially if you are pregnant, nursing, have any medical conditions, or are taking any medications.

<script>
  (function () {
    'use strict';

    var reveals = document.querySelectorAll('.ls-reveal');
    if (!reveals.length) return;

    var eachReveal = function (callback) {
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(reveals, callback);
    };

    var revealAll = function () {
      eachReveal(function (el) {
        el.classList.add('ls-visible');
        el.classList.remove('ls-ready');
      });
    };

    var motionOk = window.matchMedia && !window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

    if (!motionOk || !('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
      revealAll();
      return;
    }

    try {
      eachReveal(function (el) { el.classList.add('ls-ready'); });

      var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
        entries.forEach(function (entry) {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            entry.target.classList.add('ls-visible');
            entry.target.classList.remove('ls-ready');
            observer.unobserve(entry.target);
          }
        });
      }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -30px 0px' });

      eachReveal(function (el) { observer.observe(el); });
      window.setTimeout(revealAll, 1600);
    } catch (error) {
      revealAll();
    }
  })();
</script>

websiteDescription.value: Elevate your hydration routine with Peach Mango HYDRATION, a delicious drink that combines essential electrolytes to keep you hydrated and energized. RESTORIA — Magnesium Glycinate
Magnesium Glycinate Capsules deliver one of the most bioavailable forms of magnesium, helping your body maintain optimal levels of this essential mineral. Magnesium is vital for hundreds of biochemical reactions, including those that support nerve function, muscle health, and energy production. This gentle, well-tolerated form is ideal for individuals seeking daily support for relaxation.
Whether you’re winding down after a long day or recovering from physical activity, magnesium glycinate helps support muscle relaxation and nervous system. It also plays a role in healthy sleep patterns, making it a great addition to your nighttime wellness routine.
Each capsule provides 275 mg of elemental magnesium sourced from 2,500 mg of magnesium glycinate for optimal absorption and effectiveness. With no artificial additives and a clean, simple formula, Magnesium Glycinate Capsules are perfect for supporting overall well-being, day and night.*
Ingredients: Magnesium (from 2,500mg Magnesium Glycinate) 275mg, Hypromellose (capsule), Magnesium Stearate, Silicon Dioxide, Rice Flour.
Manufacturer Country: USA
Amount: 90 capsules
Gross Weight: 4oz / 0.25lb / 113g
Suggested Use: As a dietary supplement, take three (3) capsules once daily or as directed by your healthcare professional.
Caution: Do not exceed recommended dose. Pregnant or nursing mothers, children under the age of 18, and individuals with a known medical condition should consult a physician before using this or any dietary supplement.
Warning: Keep out of reach of children. Do not use if the safety seal is damaged or missing. Store in a cool, dry place.

      (function setHeaderHeighCustomProperties() {
        const header = document.querySelector('header-component');
        const headerGroup = document.querySelector('#header-group');
        const hasHeaderSection = headerGroup?.querySelector('.header-section');

        if (!header || !headerGroup) return;

        const headerTopRow = header.querySelector('.header__row--top');
        const headerHeight = header.offsetHeight;

        let headerGroupHeight = 0;
        const children = headerGroup.children;
        for (let i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
          const element = children[i];
          if (element === header || !(element instanceof HTMLElement)) continue;
          headerGroupHeight += element.offsetHeight;
        }

        if (header.hasAttribute('transparent') && header.parentElement?.nextElementSibling) {
          headerGroupHeight += headerHeight;
        }

        document.body.style.setProperty('--header-height', `${headerHeight}px`);
        document.body.style.setProperty('--header-group-height', `${headerGroupHeight}px`);

        if (headerTopRow) {
          window.requestAnimationFrame(function () {
            document.body.style.setProperty('--top-row-height', `${headerTopRow.offsetHeight}px`);
          });
        }

        if (!hasHeaderSection || !header?.hasAttribute('transparent')) {
          document.body.style.setProperty('--transparent-header-offset-boolean', '0');
          return;
        }

        const hasImmediateSection = hasHeaderSection.nextElementSibling?.classList.contains('shopify-section');
        const shouldApplyOffset = !hasImmediateSection ? '1' : '0';
        document.body.style.setProperty('--transparent-header-offset-boolean', shouldApplyOffset);
      })();

      (function setHeaderMenuStyle() {
        const headerComponent = document.querySelector('#header-component');
        if (headerComponent) {
          const isTouchDevice = 'ontouchstart' in window && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 0;
          const overflowList = headerComponent?.querySelector('overflow-list');
          const hasReachedMinimum = overflowList && overflowList.hasAttribute('minimum-reached');
          headerComponent.dataset.menuStyle = isTouchDevice || hasReachedMinimum ? 'drawer' : 'menu';
        }
      })();

          header.classList.add('gcc-header--scrolled');
        } else {
          header.classList.remove('gcc-header--scrolled');
        }
      });

      (function setHeaderHeighCustomProperties() {
        const header = document.querySelector('header-component');
        const headerGroup = document.querySelector('#header-group');
        const hasHeaderSection = headerGroup?.querySelector('.header-section');

        if (!header || !headerGroup) return;

        const headerTopRow = header.querySelector('.header__row--top');
        const headerHeight = header.offsetHeight;

        let headerGroupHeight = 0;
        const children = headerGroup.children;
        for (let i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
          const element = children[i];
          if (element === header || !(element instanceof HTMLElement)) continue;
          headerGroupHeight += element.offsetHeight;
        }

        if (header.hasAttribute('transparent') && header.parentElement?.nextElementSibling) {
          headerGroupHeight += headerHeight;
        }

        document.body.style.setProperty('--header-height', `${headerHeight}px`);
        document.body.style.setProperty('--header-group-height', `${headerGroupHeight}px`);

        if (headerTopRow) {
          window.requestAnimationFrame(function () {
            document.body.style.setProperty('--top-row-height', `${headerTopRow.offsetHeight}px`);
          });
        }

        if (!hasHeaderSection || !header?.hasAttribute('transparent')) {
          document.body.style.setProperty('--transparent-header-offset-boolean', '0');
          return;
        }

        const hasImmediateSection = hasHeaderSection.nextElementSibling?.classList.contains('shopify-section');
        const shouldApplyOffset = !hasImmediateSection ? '1' : '0';
        document.body.style.setProperty('--transparent-header-offset-boolean', shouldApplyOffset);

<script>
  (function () {
    'use strict';

    var reveals = document.querySelectorAll('.ls-reveal');
    if (!reveals.length) return;

    var eachReveal = function (callback) {
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(reveals, callback);
    };

    var revealAll = function () {
      eachReveal(function (el) {
        el.classList.add('ls-visible');
        el.classList.remove('ls-ready');
      });
    };

    var motionOk = window.matchMedia && !window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

    if (!motionOk || !('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
      revealAll();
      return;
    }

    try {
      eachReveal(function (el) { el.classList.add('ls-ready'); });

      var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
        entries.forEach(function (entry) {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            entry.target.classList.add('ls-visible');
            entry.target.classList.remove('ls-ready');
            observer.unobserve(entry.target);
          }
        });
      }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -30px 0px' });

      eachReveal(function (el) { observer.observe(el); });
      window.setTimeout(revealAll, 1600);
    } catch (error) {
      revealAll();
    }
  })();
</script>

Vitalis NMN — Cellular Energy Formula
NMN Capsules provide 500 mg of ß-Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (purity 99.9%), a compound that plays a key role in the body’s natural production of NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide). NAD+ is involved in cellular energy metabolism and is essential for many biological processes. As NAD+ levels naturally decline with age, NMN supplementation has become increasingly popular among longevity and healthy aging enthusiasts. This formula offers a simple way to incorporate NMN into your daily wellness regimen.
Designed for high-performing professionals and proactive health consumers, NMN Capsules support cellular energy production to help maintain daily vitality. By promoting NAD+ biosynthesis, NMN helps support normal metabolic function and overall cellular health. This makes it a practical choice for individuals balancing demanding careers, active lifestyles, and long-term wellness goals. The capsule format ensures precise dosing and convenient daily use.
Research-oriented consumers interested in the science of healthy aging often look to NMN as part of a comprehensive approach to wellness. Our NMN Capsules are formulated with a single active ingredient—ß-Nicotinamide Mononucleotide—at 500 mg per serving, without unnecessary additives. When combined with a balanced diet, regular exercise, and healthy lifestyle habits, NMN supplementation can be a valuable addition to a proactive health strategy. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional before starting any dietary supplement.*

      (function setHeaderHeighCustomProperties() {
        const header = document.querySelector('header-component');
        const headerGroup = document.querySelector('#header-group');
        const hasHeaderSection = headerGroup?.querySelector('.header-section');

        if (!header || !headerGroup) return;

        const headerTopRow = header.querySelector('.header__row--top');
        const headerHeight = header.offsetHeight;

        let headerGroupHeight = 0;
        const children = headerGroup.children;
        for (let i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
          const element = children[i];
          if (element === header || !(element instanceof HTMLElement)) continue;
          headerGroupHeight += element.offsetHeight;
        }

        if (header.hasAttribute('transparent') && header.parentElement?.nextElementSibling) {
          headerGroupHeight += headerHeight;
        }

        document.body.style.setProperty('--header-height', `${headerHeight}px`);
        document.body.style.setProperty('--header-group-height', `${headerGroupHeight}px`);

        if (headerTopRow) {
          window.requestAnimationFrame(function () {
            document.body.style.setProperty('--top-row-height', `${headerTopRow.offsetHeight}px`);
          });
        }

        if (!hasHeaderSection || !header?.hasAttribute('transparent')) {
          document.body.style.setProperty('--transparent-header-offset-boolean', '0');
          return;
        }

        const hasImmediateSection = hasHeaderSection.nextElementSibling?.classList.contains('shopify-section');
        const shouldApplyOffset = !hasImmediateSection ? '1' : '0';
        document.body.style.setProperty('--transparent-header-offset-boolean', shouldApplyOffset);

<script>
  (function () {
    'use strict';

    var reveals = document.querySelectorAll('.ls-reveal');
    if (!reveals.length) return;

    var eachReveal = function (callback) {
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(reveals, callback);
    };

    var revealAll = function () {
      eachReveal(function (el) {
        el.classList.add('ls-visible');
        el.classList.remove('ls-ready');
      });
    };

    var motionOk = window.matchMedia && !window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

    if (!motionOk || !('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
      revealAll();
      return;
    }

    try {
      eachReveal(function (el) { el.classList.add('ls-ready'); });

      var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
        entries.forEach(function (entry) {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            entry.target.classList.add('ls-visible');
            entry.target.classList.remove('ls-ready');
            observer.unobserve(entry.target);
          }
        });
      }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -30px 0px' });

      eachReveal(function (el) { observer.observe(el); });
      window.setTimeout(revealAll, 1600);
    } catch (error) {
      revealAll();
    }
  })();
</script>

      (function setHeaderHeighCustomProperties() {
        const header = document.querySelector('header-component');
        const headerGroup = document.querySelector('#header-group');
        const hasHeaderSection = headerGroup?.querySelector('.header-section');

        if (!header || !headerGroup) return;

        const headerTopRow = header.querySelector('.header__row--top');
        const headerHeight = header.offsetHeight;

        let headerGroupHeight = 0;
        const children = headerGroup.children;
        for (let i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
          const element = children[i];
          if (element === header || !(element instanceof HTMLElement)) continue;
          headerGroupHeight += element.offsetHeight;
        }

        if (header.hasAttribute('transparent') && header.parentElement?.nextElementSibling) {
          headerGroupHeight += headerHeight;
        }

        document.body.style.setProperty('--header-height', `${headerHeight}px`);
        document.body.style.setProperty('--header-group-height', `${headerGroupHeight}px`);

        if (headerTopRow) {
          window.requestAnimationFrame(function () {
            document.body.style.setProperty('--top-row-height', `${headerTopRow.offsetHeight}px`);
          });
        }

        if (!hasHeaderSection || !header?.hasAttribute('transparent')) {
          document.body.style.setProperty('--transparent-header-offset-boolean', '0');
          return;
        }

        const hasImmediateSection = hasHeaderSection.nextElementSibling?.classList.contains('shopify-section');
        const shouldApplyOffset = !hasImmediateSection ? '1' : '0';
        document.body.style.setProperty('--transparent-header-offset-boolean', shouldApplyOffset);
      })();

      (function setHeaderMenuStyle() {
        const headerComponent = document.querySelector('#header-component');
        if (headerComponent) {
          const isTouchDevice = 'ontouchstart' in window && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 0;
          const overflowList = headerComponent?.querySelector('overflow-list');
          const hasReachedMinimum = overflowList && overflowList.hasAttribute('minimum-reached');
          headerComponent.dataset.menuStyle = isTouchDevice || hasReachedMinimum ? 'drawer' : 'menu';
        }
      })();

    var revealAll = function () {
